note: Cmd-K palette highlighted every row. Appended, never substituted: earlier digests for these files stay recorded under their own tickets.

entries.why: cmdk writes data-selected="true" on the active row and data-selected="false" on the rest, and the bare data-selected: variant matches the attribute being present, so every row got bg-muted. CommandItem and CommandShortcut now use data-[selected=true]: and group-data-[selected=true]/command-item:, as upstream shadcn does. No other class, prop or import moved.
